narration: In month {fork_month}, your pay had risen and your monthly saving had stayed where it was, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost's Freedom was down to {ghost_freedom}, with most of each salary committed before the month began. The ghost's Life ended {life_gap}, slightly more living in a life that was still mostly getting by. In month {widest_gap_month}, the money was furthest apart, and the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
